# DEC-00006 — Decision Trace
```text
DECISION TRACE DEC-00006

Objective:
Define the language of code and comments.

Context:
User: 'todo la creacion en ingles, los comentarios de los codigos en trilingue con explicacion total como si fuera un curso para recien iniciando en el lenguaje y programacion en si.'

Constraints:
- Code must be conventional
- Comments must teach programming itself, not just this project

Alternatives considered:
A. English-only comments  (rejected: Contradicts the explicit trilingual teaching requirement.)
B. Manual translation of prose docs only  (rejected: Does not teach while reading code.)
C. English identifiers + trilingual pedagogical comment blocks (ES/EN/PT) with a BEGINNER COURSE section  ← SELECTED

Decision:
Identifiers, types and events in English. Every file carries a trilingual header and a BEGINNER COURSE block; key logic carries stacked ES/EN/PT inline comments.

Justification:
Reading the source becomes a programming course in three languages at once.

Consequence:
Files are longer. That is accepted deliberately: teaching value outweighs brevity.

Status: APPROVED
```
## Provenance (searches that informed this decision)
- none recorded
